name: qa-team-management
description: QA team management for QA managers and heads of quality: skill matrices with gap analysis, quality status digests, structured hiring, and exec narratives. Covers capability mapping per ISTQB CTAL-TM v3.0, the hiring chain from job description to 30-60-90 onboarding, and Minto-pyramid quality narratives. An agent (qa-manager) produces the weekly red / amber / green status digest from CI, tracker, and quarantine data.
